narr: Moist and unstable air south of a frontal system across North Florida led to the formation of slow-moving showers and thunderstorms across SE Florida during the morning hours of April 15th.
ev: Significant flooding occurred in West Palm Beach along N. Flagler Drive in the 31st Street area. Several cars stalled due to deep water on the street. A rainfall measurement of 2.36 inches was received in the vicinity, with rainfall estimates of 2.5 to 3 inches in just one hour. Street flooding was also reported on Australian Avenue and 45th Street, with stalled vehicles.
